newsitem.title: USA: Rival to take $3 mln charge for facility closure.
newsitem.headline: Rival to take $3 mln charge for facility closure.

text.p: Rival Co said Wednesday it will close its Montreal production facility within the next 60 days.
The company said it will take a pre-tax charge of about $3 million in the fiscal 1997 third quarter ending March 31 for the closure.
The small appliance manufacturer said it expected to save $3 million annually as a result of the plant closing.

Canadian distribution of Bionaire products will be moved to the company's distribution facility in Mississauga, Ontario, and manufacturing of the Bionaire products will be integrated into the company's facility in Fayetteville, North Carolina, Rival said.
The closing will affect about 150 jobs, a Rival spokesman said. But the company will have to add jobs in Fayetteville, so the net loss of jobs for the company will be about 40, the spokesman said.
"The seasonality and high cost of operations in Montreal would not foster the long-term cost conscious environment that we believe Rival is known for," Rival chief executive Thomas Manning said.
Rival shares closed up 5/16 at 21-15/16 Wednesday.
